educationalModelNote: All numerical models are simplified educational models, not specifications of a real robot.

missions.title: HAZARDS & RISK
missions.concept: Risk combines severity, exposure and probability. A mitigation should change exposure/probability or the physical hazard — not relabel severity.
missions.scenario: Hazard severity and baseline exposure/probability are fixed by the scenario. Apply exposure and probability controls.
missions.goalText: Reduce risk through real mitigations while leaving scenario severity unchanged.
missions.transferText: Restore acceptable risk after exposure increases.

missions.title: PROTECTIVE STOPS & STO
missions.concept: A protective stop must manage kinetic/gravitational energy into a safe state; simply removing torque can create a fall hazard.
missions.scenario: Detection latency and surface deceleration limit are imposed. Choose approach speed and commanded controlled deceleration.
missions.goalText: Stop inside the zone without commanding more deceleration than the surface can safely support.
missions.transferText: Adapt speed/deceleration after safe braking authority falls.

missions.title: FMEA & FTA
missions.concept: Failure analysis separates severity, occurrence and detectability, then asks how prevention and diagnostics change residual priority.
missions.scenario: Severity and baseline occurrence are scenario evidence. Improve prevention and diagnostic coverage.
missions.goalText: Reduce priority with prevention/diagnostics; severity remains fixed.
missions.transferText: Strengthen prevention and diagnostics when occurrence risk rises.

missions.title: RELIABILITY & AVAILABILITY
missions.concept: Reliability describes time to failure; availability also depends on repair/recovery time.
missions.scenario: Mission length and field repair penalty are imposed. Set reliability and serviceability targets.
missions.goalText: Meet both mission reliability and fleet availability goals.
missions.transferText: Recover availability by improving reliability/service design rather than editing the field penalty.

missions.title: V&V, FAULT INJECTION & CYBER
missions.concept: Verification evidence grows when requirements are exercised under representative faults/adversarial conditions; test count alone is not coverage.
missions.scenario: Attack surface is an imposed architecture condition. Choose requirement and fault-injection coverage.
missions.goalText: Create broad evidence without ignoring fault and cyber exposure.
missions.transferText: Compensate for increased attack surface with stronger verification and fault evidence.

missions.title: SAFETY GATE
missions.concept: Demonstrate managed stopping, diagnostic coverage and residual-risk reasoning under imposed conditions.
missions.scenario: Conditions change between cases. You control speed and assurance coverage.
missions.goalText: Complete the three safety gate cases.

gateCases.name: PROTECTIVE STOP
gateCases.text: On a degraded surface, total stopping distance must stay below 0.5 m.

gateCases.name: RESIDUAL RISK
gateCases.text: Residual uncovered/undetected space must be below 8%.
